name: Xometry, Inc.
summary: Xometry, Inc. operates an artificial intelligence (AI) powered online manufacturing marketplace in the United States and internationally. The company's marketplace uses AI to assist buyers to source custom-manufactured parts and assemblies and attain instant pricing and lead times. It operates Xometry marketplace, an AI powered online marketplace that connects buyers with suppliers of manufacturing services; Xometry instant quoting engine, which prices transactions based on volume, manufacturing process, material, and location; and Thomasnet, an industrial sourcing platform that features an online directory of industrial suppliers, products, and services, as well as digital marketing service…
